title: This Bird Kicks With 5x Its Weight, and Snakes Never See It Coming
subject: secretary bird

scenes.text: One bird kicks snakes faster than you can blink, and snakes can't dodge it.
Meet the secretary bird. It hunts venomous snakes on foot, across the African savanna.
Researchers trained one to kick a rubber snake on a hidden force plate.
The kick hit with 195 newtons. That's about five times the bird's own body weight.
And the foot touched the target for only about 15 milliseconds, roughly a tenth of a blink.
A kick too fast for a snake to strike back.
